fields.label: One-liner (Card Subtitle)
fields.name: service_oneliner
fields.placeholder: e.g. Laser, RFA and glue therapy — walk-in, walk-out.
fields.instructions: Short description shown on the service card. Keep under 80 characters.

fields.label: Icon SVG Code
fields.name: service_icon_svg
fields.instructions: Paste the full <svg>...</svg> icon code. Use 20x20 or 22x22 from Lucide Icons (https://lucide.dev). Leave blank to use default icon.
fields.placeholder: <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>

fields.label: Service Thumbnail (optional)
fields.name: service_thumbnail
fields.instructions: Optional thumbnail image. If provided, used in the service single page hero.

fields.label: Full Description
fields.name: service_description
fields.instructions: Full rich-text description for the service single page.

fields.label: CTA Behaviour
fields.name: service_cta_type

choices.modal: Open Booking Popup (default — matches current site behaviour)

fields.instructions: Controls what happens when a visitor clicks 'Learn more' on this service card. Default preserves original site behaviour (opens the #book modal).

fields.label: Custom CTA URL
fields.name: service_cta_url
fields.instructions: Only used when CTA Behaviour above is set to 'Link to Custom URL'. Leave blank otherwise.
